info.title: Proxy
info.description: Virtual card issuing platform for AI agents

servers.description: API (use lk_test_ keys for sandbox, lk_live_ keys for production)

post.description: Create a new user. After creation, initiate KYC verification via POST /v1/verification/user.

get.description: Get details of a specific user.

delete.description: Delete a user. The user must have no active agents or cards.

post.description: Initiate KYC verification for a user. Returns a link for the user to complete verification.

get.description: Get the current KYC verification status for a user.

patch.description: Update user information for KYC verification.

put.description: Upload a document for KYC verification.

get.description: Get the KYC verification link for a user. Use this to retrieve the link if the user lost it or needs a fresh URL. Returns an error if KYC is already completed.

verificationUrl.description: URL for the user to complete KYC verification

error.message: User has already completed KYC verification

get.description: Get the user's credit limit, spending power, and charges.
Get the user's available funding methods including crypto deposit addresses. More funding methods (bank transfers, etc.) will be added in future releases.
List all withdrawals. Filter by userId query parameter.

post.description: Withdraw funds from a user's deposit address.

get.description: Get a specific withdrawal by ID.
List all cards across all agents for a user.
List monthly statements for a user. Statements are generated automatically at the end of each month.

post.description: Generate an on-demand statement for a custom date range. Returns the statement in JSON format. Use the statementId to download as PDF.

get.description: Get a statement by ID. Returns JSON by default, or PDF if Accept header is `application/pdf`.
List all policy templates in the organization.

post.description: Create a reusable policy template that can be applied to agents and cards.

get.description: Get details of a specific policy template.

patch.description: Update a policy template. Changes apply to future cards; existing cards keep their settings.

delete.description: Delete a policy template. Fails if the policy is currently in use by agents or cards.

get.description: List all agents in the organization. Filter by external_id to find a specific agent.

post.description: Register an AI agent with Proxy API. Registration is idempotent - registering the same external_id returns the existing agent.

409.description: Conflict - external_id already registered with different userId

get.description: Get details of a specific agent.

patch.description: Update agent properties like name, status, or spending limits.

post.description: Soft-delete an agent. This sets status to deregistered and revokes all tokens. Cards are preserved for audit but cannot transact.

get.description: List all tokens for an agent.

post.description: Create a new token for an agent. The full token is only returned once.

get.description: Get the agent's current spending policy and usage.
List all cards for a specific agent.

post.description: Issue a new virtual card for an agent.

get.description: Get details of a specific card.

patch.description: Update card spending limits. Use POST /freeze, /unfreeze, /close for status changes.

get.description: Get the card's current policy settings and status (TTL, active hours, cooldown, etc.).

post.description: Temporarily freeze a card. The card can be unfrozen later.
Unfreeze a frozen card to make it active again.
Permanently close a card. This cannot be undone.
Retrieve card credentials with attestation. Returns full PAN, CVV, and expiration. Requires a summary describing the intended use.

get.description: List all transactions for a specific card.
List all intents for your organization. Optionally filter by cardId, agentId, or status.
Get details of a specific intent by ID.

post.description: Approve a pending intent. Only intents with status `pending_approval` can be approved. Once approved, the intent status changes to `pending` and the agent can access card credentials.

400.description: Bad request (e.g., intent not in pending_approval status)

post.description: Reject a pending intent. Only intents with status `pending_approval` can be rejected. Once rejected, the agent cannot access card credentials for this intent.

400.description: Bad request (e.g., intent not in pending_approval status)

get.description: List all intents for a specific card.

post.description: Declare an intent before making a purchase. Creates an audit trail and enables transaction matching. Only available for multi-use cards.

400.description: Bad request (e.g., single-use card, frozen card)

get.description: List all transactions for your organization. Optionally filter by cardId, userId, or status.
Get details of a specific transaction.

patch.description: Update transaction metadata such as notes, tags, and category.

get.description: Get the receipt attached to a transaction.

put.description: Upload a receipt for a transaction. Supports direct file upload (image/*, application/pdf) or JSON with external URL.

url.description: External URL where receipt is hosted

mimeType.description: MIME type of the receipt (e.g., image/png, application/pdf)

delete.description: Remove the receipt from a transaction.

get.description: List all disputes for your organization. Optionally filter by userId, transactionId, or status.
Get details of a specific dispute.

patch.description: Cancel a dispute or add text evidence. Status can only be updated to 'canceled'.

get.description: Download file evidence attached to a dispute.

put.description: Upload file evidence for a dispute.

post.description: Create a dispute (chargeback) for a transaction.

409.description: Dispute already exists for this transaction

get.description: List all webhook endpoints for your organization.

post.description: Create a new webhook endpoint to receive event notifications.

secret.description: The signing secret for verifying webhook payloads. Only returned on creation.

get.description: Get details of a specific webhook endpoint.

patch.description: Update a webhook endpoint's URL, description, events, or status.

get.description: Retrieve the signing secret for a webhook endpoint. Use this to verify incoming webhook payloads.

post.description: Rotate the signing secret for a webhook endpoint. Both old and new secrets will work for 24 hours, giving you time to update your server.
Send a test event to a webhook endpoint to verify it's receiving events correctly.

get.description: List all available webhook event types that you can subscribe to.
Get your current rake (fee) configuration.
Get your accumulated fee balance.
List fee ledger entries with pagination.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of entries to return (max 100)

get.description: Get your current risk policy configuration.

patch.description: Update individual risk policy settings. Automatically switches to 'custom' preset.

post.description: Apply a preset risk configuration (permissive, moderate, strict, or paranoid).

get.description: Get available risk presets with their configurations.

post.description: Enable or disable dry-run mode. When enabled, anomalies are detected and webhooks emitted, but no actions are taken.

get.description: Get the current KYB (Know Your Business) verification status and business information for your organization.

patch.description: Update your organization's business information for KYB verification.

post.description: Get a pre-signed URL for uploading a KYB document. After uploading, call POST /v1/verification/business/documents to save the document.

get.description: List all uploaded KYB documents for your organization.

post.description: Save a document after uploading to the URL from POST /v1/verification/business/documents/upload-url.

get.description: List all beneficial owners for your organization.

post.description: Add a beneficial owner to your organization. Maximum of 4 beneficial owners allowed.

delete.description: Remove a beneficial owner from your organization.

post.description: Initiate Persona verification for a beneficial owner. Sends an email with a verification link.
Submit your KYB application for review. Requires completed business info, all required documents, and at least one verified beneficial owner.
